results.title: Candidate Privacy - Comcast Careers
results.content: This Privacy Notice to Job Candidates (“CN Privacy Notice”) explains how Comcast Corporation and Comcast Cable and Comcast Cable’s subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively, “Comcast”, “we”, “our” or “us”), collects, uses, and otherwise processes candidate-related personal information (sometimes referred to as “Candidate Information”) during its recruitment and selection process, including when you access or use our careers website. This CN Privacy Notice applies to any personal information Comcast collects once an individual expresses interest in being employed at Comcast. To the extent Comcast has collected your Sensitive Personal Information, you have the right to request that we restrict our use of it in some cases. If we make material changes to this CN Privacy Notice that increase our rights to use personal information that we have previously collected about you, we will notify you through written, electronic, or other means, as permitted by law, so that you can make any necessary decisions about your ongoing use of our services.
